H01.description: Initialises the per-hop unverified flag used by the D1 fix.

H02.description: The calibration exit records and prints the raw provider error text (str(_exc)) under message_redacted and in stderr JSON without passing it through the redaction helper.

H03.description: message_redacted is filled with the unredacted provider error string.

H04.description: The stderr error JSON embeds the unredacted provider error string.

H05.description: The 'above the probed bound' status is taken from the chain head (_ceiling_unverified) instead of computed per hop, so a calibrated fallback's ordinary 429 is not walked and is recorded as RATE_LIMIT_UNVERIFIED, and its context verdict is misclassed as CEILING_UNVERIFIED_LIMIT.

H06.description: Provider context-limit class on a fallback hop uses the head's unverified status rather than the hop's own.

H07.description: A 429 on a calibrated fallback hop ends the call as RATE_LIMIT_UNVERIFIED (not walked) because the head's unverified status is inherited.

H08.description: Adds the premium-before-flooring helper used by the D3 fix.

H09.description: Comment update describing the corrected premium computation.

H10.description: The long-context premium multiplies already-floored per-category costs (and float-multiplies), underbilling by the discarded remainders and leaving remainders unscaled.

H11.description: The multiplier parser accepts non-finite values (inf, nan, 1e309) and booleans, which later crash or explode the cost calculation instead of defaulting to 1.0.

H12.description: Only m > 0 is checked, so inf passes and nan falls through inconsistently instead of requiring a finite positive multiplier.

H13.description: Imports fcntl for the D5 lock.

H14.description: record_observed's read-append-replace cycle is unlocked, so concurrent writers load the same store and the later os.replace discards the earlier row.

H15.description: Moves directory creation before the lock as part of the D5 fix.

H16.description: Adds regression tests for per-hop unverified status and message redaction.

H17.description: Adds concurrency and symlink tests for record_observed.

H18.description: Adds pricing tests for premium flooring and non-finite multipliers.
